target_customer: B2B customer support and technical support teams
problem: Support teams spend time on repetitive tickets and issue investigation across many tools.
business_model: B2B SaaS agent platform sold by demo
product_category: AI agents for customer and technical support

founders.name: Valerie Li
founders.background_notes: Tech lead at Netflix per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agent orchestration across tools with testing and policy controls is demanding but standard LLM engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and agents embedded in workflows add some stickiness; underlying models are commodity.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Support platforms shipped AI agents and many AI support startups launched; no acquisition of Duckie found.

market_need_then: Support volume and cost pressures plus LLM capability drove demand for AI support in 2024.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; a similar sounding company Ducky raised a pre-seed in 2024, so there is some confusion risk.

pivots.from: AI technical support assistant for Slack, Jira and Confluence
pivots.to: agentic platform for building support agents
pivots.why: YC launch post versus current site; date approximate.

outcome_analysis: Duckie shows sixteen customer logos and testimonials such as an Automox team reporting a drop from three support staff to one while handling 30 percent more tickets, which is self reported. Funding is unclear, with one source saying it is bootstrapped, and competition is heavy, so it is an active small company with some customer evidence and no verified exit.
notes: Funding conflicting and unverified: VCBacked and CB Insights say about $500K in March or April 2024 from YC and others; Latka says bootstrapped with $0 raised and $440K revenue. No round recorded. Competition: results were only 2026 comparison pages, list empty. The YC page names Duckie; do not confuse with Ducky AI. Name origin not found. UPDATE (completeness pass): a $500K pre-seed around March 2024 rests on databases (VCBacked, CB Insights seed dated 2024-03-28, Sig.ai); investor lists differ and Latka claims no outside funding, so this is single-database level and conflicting.
